notes: Investigated thoroughly, no genuine New Arrivals PLP exists on xxxlutz.de. Checked: (1) Main nav / mega menu / footer - no 'Neuheiten'/'Neu'/'Neu im Sortiment' nav item anywhere; the only on-page use of 'Neuheiten' is generic placeholder text in the header search box ('Suche nach Produkten, Marken oder Neuheiten' - search-box copy, not a link). (2) Guessed direct URLs /neuheiten, /neu, /c/neuheiten, /c/neu-im-sortiment, /c/online-neuheiten, /c/neue-produkte, /c/aktuelle-neuheiten, /c/must-haves, /c/new-in, /c/neuheiten-moebel, /c/trends all return the bare client-side SPA shell (~4.5KB, identical across repeated retries with rotated curl_cffi browser profiles), confirmed non-existent by contrast with known-good category URLs (e.g. /gartenmoebel-C8) which render full SSR content (~1.3-1.5MB) reliably. (3) Site's own search for 'Neuheiten' returned 0 results (title: 'Oh nein! Fuer die Suche Neuheiten gibt es leider keine Ergebnisse'). (4) sitemap-categories.xml (5674 URLs) grepped for neu*/neuheit*/neuankomm* - zero matching category nodes. (5) Extracted the site's full eyecatcher-badge registry from GraphQL SSR data and DID find a genuine badge/facet code 'new' (localized label 'Neu') - this is a real, user-facing filter chip inside the 'Angebote & Bestellbarkeit' (Offers & Availability) facet group present on every category page (verified e.g. https://www.xxxlutz.de/gartenmoebel-C8?p_eyecatcher=Neu returns totalResults=229, pageSize=60, totalPages=4, exhaustion check passes). However, unlike the Abverkauf/Clearance case, this 'Neu' facet has NO corresponding site-built hub/landing page and is not surfaced through any nav item, footer link, or curated CMS content anywhere discovered - it is purely one generic attribute-style filter chip alongside color/material/brand/price facets. This company's own prior Home-Decor extraction pass explicitly established the convention that such query-string facet variants (?p_color=, ?pa_material=, ?ec_brand=, etc.) are non-canonical facet re-cuts, not separate site-defined categories - the same convention applies here, in contrast to Abverkauf which was elevated by an actual dedicated CMS page (/c/online-lagerraeumungsverkauf) explicitly curating and linking to it. Per the brief's caution against inventing sub-categories the site itself doesn't present as a merchandising concept, concluded no genuine New Arrivals PLP exists.
